//: ADR-001 §D1: solution-style project references. Holds no files of its own — `tsc -b` here emits every referenced library's declarations in dependency order. Apps are absent by construction: a reference target must set `composite: true`, which TypeScript forbids alongside the `noEmit: true` Next requires. Apps are type-checked per project by `nx run-many -t typecheck`. See docs/migration/mdrs-11-nx-task-orchestration.md §5.
